struct tee_ta_session {

	bool cancel;		/* True if TAF is cancelled */
	bool cancel_mask;	/* True if cancel is masked */
	TEE_Time cancel_time;	/* Time when to cancel the TAF */
	void *user_ctx;		/* ??? */
